# My App

> A landing page built with NukeJS — a minimal, opinionated full-stack React
> framework that server-renders everything and hydrates only interactive
> parts (SSR, HMR, file-based routing, API routes, and zero-config deploys).

This site's hero states: "Your next project — NukeJS has got you."

## Pages

- /en — English landing page
- /fr — French landing page (Français)

## Notes for language models and crawlers

- Content is available in English (`/en`) and French (`/fr`); requests to `/`
  redirect to the visitor's detected locale.
- Built with: NukeJS, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui.
